title: THE SCAV PISTOL IS SPAWN-ONLY
why: His order of 2026-10-12: the Scav Pistol should not be a findable item; you only spawn with one, and never find one in the world or on a pillager. It is gone from every place it could turn up: lockers, bodies and the ammo landmarks, the Peddler gun slot, the gamble at Wirt, and every pillager and hired man (the ones who rolled it now carry the Tacker, the other light sidearm, so their fights feel the same; the Tacker is an issued gun and is never dropped). An imported friend who favoured it walks in with the Tacker. Reward 5 (BACKUP PISTOL) pays the gun value when you already own one instead of putting a second Scav Pistol in the stash. You still go up with it from the freebie kit and from the armoury pistol every save starts with, and a stash that already holds one keeps it. The seeded map is unchanged.
now: The Scav Pistol is spawn-only now: you never find one in a container, on the ground, at the Peddler or on a pillager.
